= escaped-macros(1)
:manmanual: Escape tests
:mansource: acdc
:acdc-index:
:label: Attribute \] text

== Name
escaped-macros - literal macro labels

== Description

S01 Normal \indexterm2:[Label \] text].

[subs="-macros"]
S02 indexterm2:[Disabled \] text] and ((Disabled short \] text)).

[subs="macros,attributes"]
S03 \indexterm2:[{label}].

[subs="attributes,macros"]
S04 \indexterm2:[{label}].

[source,text,subs="+macros"]
----
S05 \indexterm2:[Code \] text]
S06 \xref:target[Code \] text]
S07 footnote:[Code \] note]
----

[subs="none"]
S08 indexterm2:[No substitutions \] text].

[subs="macros,quotes,replacements"]
S09 \indexterm2:[*Late* -- \] text].

[subs="macros,attributes"]
S10 footnote:[Frozen {label} \] note].

S11 footnote:[Early {label} \] note].

[index]
